claims.claim: About 56% of the fugue is occupied by the six episodes, all interrelated, developing figures from subject and countersubject.
Order of entry soprano-middle-bass; countersubject above answer in bar 3 and above subject in bar 5; themes not interchanged until the redundant entry in bar 10.
The redundant answer at bar 10 has the shape of an ornamented subject; the final entry (bar 51) uses the same ornamentation.
Exposition simple (no codetta), extended by a redundant entry of the answer at bar 10.
Final section is a recapitulation of the exposition (42-48) capped by another subject entry in I (bar 51).
